title: Error message displayed when searching for non-existent site or user
description: An error message appears in the UI when searching for a site or user that does not exist in the system, instead of displaying an appropriate 'no results' message.
steps: In the search bar, enter a site name that is confirmed not to exist.
Tap 'Current Site' to open Site details.
Navigate back to the previous screen.
In the search bar, enter an email address that is confirmed not to exist.
actual: When searching for a non-existent site or user, an error message is displayed in the UI. For example, after searching for a non-existent site, an error message like 'Error retrieving site information' might appear. Similarly, when searching for a non-existent user, a similar error message might be shown.
expected: When searching for a site or user that does not exist, the system should display a clear 'No results found' or similar message, indicating that the search yielded no matches. No error messages should be displayed in the UI.
